create_ExaoneConfig: create an ExaoneConfig instance with default model architecture parameters
create_ExaoneConfig_custom: create an ExaoneConfig with custom vocab_size, hidden_size, and num_layers for a smaller model
create_ExaoneConfig_gqa: create an ExaoneConfig using grouped query attention by setting num_key_value_heads less than num_attention_heads
create_ExaoneConfig_rope_scaling: create an ExaoneConfig with rope_scaling dict for linear RoPE position embedding extension
create_ExaoneConfig_long_context: create an ExaoneConfig with max_position_embeddings set to 4096 for long context sequences
